Advanced Science | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 This work introduces a thermally triggered in situ gelling foam using nano-CaCO3 and GDL, enabling alginate crosslinking only upon battery fire exposure. The strategy combines low-viscosity foamability with fire-activated gelation, forming a stable adhesive barrier that outperforms water mist, spray, and AFFF in suppressing single-cell fires and preventing thermal runaway propagation, offering a promising safety solution for lithium-ion battery systems.

Advanced Science | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 This work uniquely resolves how graphite staging heterogeneity evolves in 3D and scales with charging kinetics, revealing that lithium plating is spatially templated by pre-existing staging non-uniformity rather than random nucleation. It establishes staging heterogeneity as a kinetically controlled precursor to plating and provides a general operando framework for diagnosing heterogeneity-driven behavior in insertion electrodes.
